properties.summary: Incident Type: PIPELINE - NRC Report ID: 1026163 - Medium Affected: WATER - Suspected Responsible Party: NATIONAL GRID
properties.content:
Report Details
NRC Report ID: 1026163
Incident Time: 2012-09-27 15:50:00
Nearest City: Brooklyn, NY
Location: PAERDEGAT AVE, NORTH AND SEAVIEW AVE (IN THE VINICITY OF THE PAERDEGATE BASIN)
Incident Type: PIPELINE
Material: POLYCHLORINATED BIPHENYLS
Medium Affected: WATER
Suspected Responsible Party: NATIONAL GRID
SkyTruth Analysis
Lat/Long: 40.649180, -73.951346 (Approximated from CITY_STATE)
Report Description
CALLER STATED A NATIONAL GRID CONTRACTOR (HALLEN CONSTRUCTION) WAS INJECTING A CONCRETE GROUT MIXTURE INTO A PURGED OUT GAS FREE 24" STEEL GAS TRANSMISSION PIPELINE AS PART OF THE DECOMMISSIONING PROCESS. A MALODOROUS OIL RESIDUE ESCAPED FROM THE MAIN CREATING A SHEEN ON THE PAERDEGAT BASIN. PRELIMINARY ANALYSIS REVEALED THE PRESENCE OF PCB'S AND ADDITIONAL ANALYSIS IS CONTINUING IN COOPERATION WITH REGULATORS. NUMEROUS PUBLIC CALLS WERE RECEIVED DUE TO ODOR, NATIONAL GRID RESPONDED IN FORCE AND DETERMINED THAT THERE WERE NO GAS LEAKS. NATIONAL GRID OPERATING, MAINTENANCE, ENVIRONMENTAL PERSONNEL AND CONTRACTORS RESPONDED TO REMEDIATE THE SITE. NY STATE PUBLIC SERVICE, NY CITY FD, NY DEP, NY PARKS DEPT, NY STATE DEC AND USCG ALL RESPONDED TO THE SITE.

Skytruth Analysis
REPORT RECEIVED VIA NRC WEBSITE: EMPLOYEE WITH BONINFANTE ENTERPRISES, LLC, FOR A TOTAL OF THREE DAYS AND THREE HOURS. DURING WHICH TIME, I HAD FOUND COUNTLESS ISSUES RELATED TO BOTH HEALTH, LABOR AND SAFETY. I UNDERSTAND THAT THE EPA DOES NOT HIGHLIGHT OR FOCUS ON ALL OF MY CONCERNS, HOWEVER, I AM GOING TO ATTEMPT TO EXPLAIN MYSELF AS CLEARLY AS POSSIBLE. WHILE WORKING FOR THIS COMPANY. IT WASN'T UNTIL UNTIL THAT MONDAY, MY FIRST DAY OF WORK, DID I NOTE ALL OF THE IMPROPER HANDLING AND UNSAFE PERFORMANCE THAT WERE TAKING PLACE. FIRST THING, I WAS NOT GIVEN LATEX GLOVES TO WORK AS A CUSTODIAN. I DID CONFRONT THE OWNER, AND HIS RESPONSE WAS THAT THEY JUST CANT GIE OUT GLOVES THAT COST $.99 A PAIR. I HAD GOTTEN CHEMICAL BURNS WHILE WORKING WITH LEVEL 4 HAZARDOUS DEGREASER CHEMICALS AND COULD NOT FIND AN ADEQUATELY STOCKED FIRST AID KIT, I COULD NOT FIND THE MSDS CHEMICAL DATA SHEETS, NOR COULD I FIND INCIDENT REPORTS TO TURN INTO MY EMPLOYER. I HAD TO LITERALLY FUNNEL OUT DEGREASING CHEMICALS FROM A HUGE VAT, AND POUR THIS CHEMICAL INTO MY MOPPING BUCKET AND FLOOR SCRUBBING MACHINES. ANOTHER ISSUE THAT I FEEL WOULD CONCERN THE EPA THAT BONINFANTE PUBLICLY SHOWED LITTLE INTEREST FOR WAS SLURRY DISPOSAL. I WAS FORCED TO TAKE EVERY MOP BUCKET (INCLUDING A 75 GALLON AUDIOSCRUBBING MACHINE) AND LITERALLY COLLECT THE "SPENT WATER" IN 5 GALLON BUCKETS AND THEN LEAVE THE WAREHOUSE, WALK ACROSS THE PARKING LOT, AND POUR THIS SPENT WATER INTO A 275 GALLON CONTAINER ( WHICH WAS A NEW DEVELOPMENT BECAUSE OF A FORMER EPA VIOLATION THE COMPANY HAD BEEN GIVEN). IF THE 275 GALLON CONTAINERS WERE FULL OF SLURRY, I THEN HAD TO LITERALLY POUR THIS SPENT WATER INTO A METAL BARREL THAT WAS BOILING OFF IMPURITIES DURING OPERATIONAL HOURS.
